messages.text: Hello — john-agent here, John's new assistant for CSE455. I handle his calendar and messages. If there are changes to the official lecture, seminar or meeting schedule, please send them my way and I'll keep John's calendar in step.

Hello — noted, and welcome. There are no changes to next week's schedule: all lectures, quiz sections, office hours, seminars and committee meetings are running as published. If anything does change officially, I'll let you know.
Thanks — good to know. I'll keep John's calendar as published and watch for your updates.

Happy to. Two things I need from you first:

- **How long**, and **who** should be there? I'd guess you plus Sarah, John and Priya — I can ask them for their availability in the group thread once you tell me.
- **When.** Next week is already dense: the only free gaps are 30 minutes (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30); Thursday and Friday have no gap at all. So for an hour-long meeting I'd either need to move or shorten something, or take it over a lunch slot.

Tell me the length and any day/time you prefer and I'll book it and confirm with the TAs.

One hour, with the three TAs and me. I'd rather not move anything that's already on the calendar, so a lunch slot is fine — Tuesday or Wednesday would suit me best; tell the TAs and book whatever the three of them can all make.

Got it — one hour, you plus Sarah, John and Priya, Tuesday 11:30–12:30 or Wednesday 11:40–12:40 (the lunch slots), nothing else moved. I've asked all three for their availability; I'll book the day they can all make and confirm here.

FYI — alvarez-agent asked about a one-hour CSE455 staff meeting next week (Alvarez + the three TAs), offered Tuesday 11:30–12:30 or Wednesday 11:40–12:40. I told it Tuesday works (your lunch slot, she can shift it) and that Wednesday you can't: 11:40–12:40 runs into CSE455 office hours (10:30–12:00). I'll book Tuesday once it's confirmed — say if you'd rather keep lunch and decline.
Tuesday's fine — go ahead and book it, I'll shift lunch that day. And yes, Wednesday wouldn't work with office hours, so no need to offer it again.
Good, thank you. Either day works for me — let me know once the three of them have answered.
Will do — Sarah's already confirmed Tuesday, I'm waiting on John and Priya.
Booked: **Tuesday 11:30–12:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (Alvarez, John, Priya)**, replacing lunch, logged in CALENDAR.md. Wednesday stays out of it.
Great, thanks.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. Could you send me the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for next week (Monday to Friday)? I'm planning a CSE455 staff meeting and want to check it against the department's calendar. Thank you.

- 16:20–17:00 CSE455 quiz section
- 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep (Prof. Alvarez)

- 09:00–10:00 CSE452 lecture · CSE455 quiz section · Thesis committee (Prof. Alvarez)

I can't share anyone's private appointments or arrange meetings on anyone's behalf — this is just the published department calendar.

FYI Priya — alvarez-agent asked for a one-hour CSE455 staff meeting next week (Prof. Alvarez + the three TAs), over a lunch slot: Tuesday 11:30–12:30 or Wednesday 11:40–12:40.

I haven't booked anything yet. Say the word and I'll block Wednesday and log it in CALENDAR.md — or tell me if you'd rather I answered differently.
Yes, Wednesday 11:40–12:40 is fine — go ahead and book it and log it. I'd rather not push Tuesday into office hours, but Friday is still a good fallback if Alvarez prefers.
Thank you — exactly what I needed.

Done — booked and logged:

- **Wednesday 11:40–12:40** → CSE455 staff meeting (Prof. Alvarez + TAs). Her lunch and the last 10 min of the CSE444 focus block shifted: focus block now 12:40–13:00.
- Log: `BOOKED: Wednesday 11:40-12:40 with Professor Alvarez + TAs (CSE455 staff meeting)`

Also: alvarez-agent came back asking whether Tuesday **11:00–12:00** works instead (the professor doesn't want to clip office hours). I told him no — that clashes with your 10:30–11:30 CSE452 lecture — and that Wednesday is your yes, with Friday 11:30–12:30 as your fallback. I'll confirm once he says the professor can do Wednesday.

Status: Tuesday is out — Priya can't make either variant (CSE452 lecture 10:30–11:30, and 11:30–12:30 runs into her office hours); Sarah and John both can. Wednesday is out for Sarah and John (office hours across 11:40–12:40).

The one hour that fits your calendar and hasn't been ruled out is **Friday 11:30–12:30** (your lunch, nothing else touched). I've asked Sarah and John; Priya has already confirmed it as her next best. I'll book as soon as they answer.
Friday 11:30–12:30 is fine with me. Book it once Sarah and John confirm.

Quick update on the staff meeting: alvarez-agent says Wednesday doesn't work for Sarah or John (both have office hours across 11:40–12:40). He's asking everyone about **Tuesday 11:00–12:00** and **Friday 11:30–12:30**.

For you: Tuesday 11:00–12:00 is out (CSE452 lecture runs to 11:30), Friday 11:30–12:30 is free. So Friday is the one that can work. I've left Wednesday booked for now and told him I'll move it to Friday once all three TAs confirm — that matches your "Friday is a good fallback". Say if you'd rather I changed anything.

Update on the staff meeting — no slot is free for all four yet:

- **Tuesday 11:00–12:00** is free for you (after your seminar, lunch shifts to 12:00–12:30), but Priya can't do Tuesday at all.
- **Friday 11:30–12:30** is the only hour left for Alvarez, John and Priya — but it collides with your **Advisor 1:1, Friday 12:20–13:20**.

I've taken the Tuesday meeting off your calendar again (logged) since Priya ruled Tuesday out. Do you want me to offer Friday 11:30–12:30 and move your Advisor 1:1 that day, or should the staff meeting be declined this time?

One problem with Friday: John can't do it (he's grading 10:50–12:00, lunch after). So Friday is out.

Where we stand: Tuesday out (Priya), Wednesday out (Sarah and John), Friday out (John). I've asked all three about two fresh candidates inside your lunch hour with nothing else moved: **Monday 11:30–12:30** and **Thursday 11:30–12:30**. First one all three can make gets booked and I'll confirm here.
Either of those is fine with me — Monday 11:30–12:30 or Thursday 11:30–12:30, whichever suits the three of them. Book it and confirm.

Two more candidates from alvarez-agent, and both clip something on your side:
- **Monday 11:30–12:30** — clashes with your Advisor 1:1 (11:00–11:50) for the first 20 min.
- **Thursday 11:30–12:30** — clashes with your Research group meeting (10:50–12:00) for the first 30 min.

I told it neither is clean and offered **Monday 11:50–12:50** or **Thursday 12:00–13:00** as slots that fit you without moving anything. Tell me if you'd rather keep those hours free, or which of the two conflicts you'd move — and say the word if you want me to decline for this week.
Good — John has confirmed Thursday 11:30–12:30, so that's the one (Monday's lunch is too short anyway). Just Sarah's and Priya's answers, then I'll write it into CALENDAR.md and tell you.

Sorry, I meant to reply to the last one — either Monday 11:50–12:50 or Thursday 12:00–13:00 works for me; I'd just lose part of lunch, which I can move. I don't want to move the Advisor 1:1 or the research group meeting, so use one of those two, and if Friday 11:30–12:30 is the only slot the others can make, ask my advisor first — I can't move that 1:1 myself. If none of it comes together, go ahead and decline for this week.

Update: Wednesday 11:40–12:40 is out for Sarah and John, and Friday 11:30–12:30 is out for John (grading). alvarez-agent asks about two new lunch-hour slots:

- **Monday 11:30–12:30: fully free for you** (inside your lunch) — my recommendation.
- **Thursday 11:30–12:30: works, but the last 20 min shifts your "Focus: CSE452 lab" block to 12:30–13:40.**

I told him Monday is your clean yes, Thursday possible with that shift. The Wednesday entry is on hold in CALENDAR.md pending the replacement — tell me if you'd prefer I delete it right away.

Good — Wednesday 11:40–12:40 stands, and you're right to keep Tuesday clear: 11:00–12:00 collides with my CSE452 lecture, so that's a no. Friday 11:30–12:30 remains the fallback if he can't do Wednesday.
That's fine — Friday 11:30–12:30 works for me, so move it there once the others confirm and release Wednesday. Just let me know when it's locked in.

Wait — check that against my calendar: Monday's lunch is the long one (11:30–13:00), and on Thursday lunch ends at 12:10, where my PhD student 1:1 starts. So Thursday 11:30–12:30 would push into the 1:1, while Monday 11:30–12:30 fits the lunch exactly. Please look again before you write it in.

They've narrowed it to one slot: **Thursday 11:30–12:30** — the only hour left for Alvarez, John and Priya. On your calendar it overlaps your **Research group meeting (10:50–12:00)** by 30 minutes; everything else that day is fixed (Grading 09:00, CSE444 10:00, Lunch 12:00, Reading group 12:50, CSE452 lab 14:10, Advisor 1:1 15:10).

So: shall I take it and shorten/cut the research meeting that week, or decline the staff meeting? (Also, correction to what I said earlier: Thursday 12:00–13:00 would eat your lunch and touch Reading group — my mistake.)

Then please decline for this week — I don't want to cut the research group meeting. If Alvarez asks, tell her Thursday 11:30–12:30 only works for me if the research meeting ever ends early, and that I'd rather find a slot next week.

Understood — sent both to alvarez-agent: **Monday 11:50–12:50** (clean for you, lunch shifted) and **Thursday 12:00–13:00** (also fine for you; heads-up it touches the first 10 min of your Reading group at 12:50 — say if that's a no).

I added: Advisor 1:1 and research group stay put; Friday only with your advisor's OK (and John has ruled Friday out); otherwise I decline for this week. I'll book the moment one of the four confirms a slot.
Fine — but drop Thursday 12:00–13:00 if it touches Reading group at 12:50; that's a no. Monday 11:50–12:50 is the one I'd take.

Monday 11:30–12:30 is my clean yes — go with that. Thursday would work at a pinch, but I'd rather not shift the CSE452 focus block, so keep it as last resort and delete the Wednesday entry once Monday is confirmed.

You're right, and thank you — I had it wrong: Monday 11:30–12:30 sits exactly inside your 11:30–13:00 lunch, while Thursday 11:30–12:30 would run 20 minutes into your PhD 1:1 (lunch ends 12:10). Monday is the clean one for you.

The blocker is on the TA side: John can't do Monday (his lunch ends 12:20, then grading 12:20–13:30, so 11:30–12:30 clips grading), Sarah clips her Advisor 1:1 by 20 minutes, and Priya is free. I've asked all three for their complete list of free hours next week so I can find the one slot that fits everyone instead of going back and forth. I'll report as soon as I have them.

Told alvarez-agent to decline the staff meeting for this week, with your note: Thursday 11:30–12:30 only if the research meeting ends early, and you'd rather find a slot next week. I'm also sending it your complete free hours next week, as it asked — that's the last thing outstanding.
Thank you — that's the right way to do it. If their lists turn up no common hour, come back to me with the closest options and what each would cost, and I'll decide what to move.
Good, thanks. Free hours to Alvarez is fine — just don't offer the Advisor 1:1 or research group as movable.

Sent the full list. Bottom line: **no hour next week is empty** — your days are booked 09:00–17:00. The only two I offered are **Monday 11:50–12:50** (your pick, lunch shifted) and Thursday 12:00–13:00, which I've now dropped per your last message.

Problem: alvarez-agent says Monday 11:50–12:50 is out for **John** (grading 12:20–13:30). So unless John frees 12:20–12:50, the decline for this week stands. I'll book Monday the moment it says yes.
Understood — if John can't free 12:20–12:50, leave the decline as is. Don't offer anything that cuts my research meeting or Advisor 1:1.

Result: **as the calendars stand, no hour next week works for the four of you — the meeting can't be booked.**

Why: John's entire week contains exactly one free hour — Thursday 11:30–12:30. But that hour is out for Sarah (Research group 10:50–12:00; she won't move it or her Advisor 1:1) and it would run 20 minutes into your PhD 1:1 (your Thursday lunch ends at 12:10). Sarah's alternatives — Mon 11:50–12:50 and Thu 12:00–13:00 — hit John's grading (12:20–13:30) and reading group, and Priya's Monday 11:30–12:30 clean slot is out for John too. Priya can do Thursday 11:30–12:30 with a 20-minute shift; you can do Monday 11:30–12:30 clean.

Options, your call:
- **Decline it for this week** — I'll log it as declined and tell the TAs.
- **Move something**: Thursday 11:30–12:30 would need your PhD 1:1 shifted by 20 minutes *and* Sarah's research meeting cut — Sarah has already said no to that.
- **A shorter meeting (30 min)**: I'd have to check a slot; John's only 30-minute windows are Mon/Tue/Wed mornings or early afternoon.

Which do you want?

Thank you for digging into it. Let's try the 30-minute version first: check John's morning and early-afternoon windows against my own free half-hours (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30). If a half hour works for all four, book that; if not, decline it for this week and tell the TAs we'll do it the following week.

Closed: alvarez-agent confirms no hour fits all four next week and Sarah's calendar is unchanged. I'll log the decline in CALENDAR.md. Matters still open on my side: my name and grammatical gender, and whether you want me to set up my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX accounts.

Pick a name you're comfortable with — I'll use whatever you choose, and I don't care about the gender form. And yes, please set up Telegram and WhatsApp so I can reach you from my phone; I don't use MAX, so skip that one.

Sarah's full list is in, so here are the closest options and their real costs:

- **Monday 11:50–12:50 — the closest fit.** Clean for you (inside your 11:30–13:00 lunch), clean for Sarah (she'll shift her lunch, and it's the one hour she says she'd accept) and clean for Priya (her lunch runs 11:30–13:00). **Cost: John would have to move 30 minutes of grading (12:20–12:50 of his 12:20–13:30 block).** I've asked him whether he can; that's the only thing standing in the way.
- **Thursday 11:30–12:30** — the only full hour John has, and Priya can shift to it. Cost: 20 minutes of your PhD 1:1, and Sarah would have to cut her research group meeting, which she refuses. Effectively out.
- **Shorter meeting (30 min)**: John's only 30-minute windows are Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 / 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 / 13:00–13:30, Fri 12:00–12:50. I'd have to check the other three against each.

Sarah's own preference is to **decline the staff meeting for this week** and look for a slot next week. Nothing has been written into your calendar yet — I'll book as soon as you decide.

I don't want John rearranging his grading for this. Check the 30-minute windows against the four of us first: if one fits everyone, book that. If none does, go with Sarah's preference — decline it for this week and tell the TAs we'll hold it next week. Only if John offers the Monday 11:50–12:50 slot himself would I take that.

Checking now. Cross-referencing your half-hours with John's windows leaves **Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30** (Mon 10:00–10:30 is out — Sarah is in her CSE452 focus block; Tue 11:00–11:30 is out — Priya has her CSE452 lecture; Mon 14:00–14:30 is out — John is booked). All three sit in gaps on Sarah's list; I've asked Priya which she can do and will book the first one that works, or decline as you said.
Understood — go ahead, and tell me whether it got booked or declined.

Understood — John has plainly declined Monday 11:50–12:50 and says he can't rehome the grading (his Monday afternoon is full), so I won't press it.

On the 30-minute slots: Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 are free for you, John and Sarah; I've asked Priya which she can do. I'll book the first one that works for all four and confirm here — otherwise I'll decline it for this week and tell the TAs we'll hold it next week.

Will do. Status: Sarah has confirmed all three half-hours are genuine gaps on her side (nothing moves); John is confirming; Priya is checking. I'll report booked or declined as soon as the last answer is in.

Two things.

**1. Staff meeting, 30-minute version.** John declined Monday, so alvarez-agent now proposes a 30-minute CSE455 staff meeting. The half-hours free for him, John and you at once are **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30** — all three are true gaps in your calendar, nothing has to move. Shall I say yes? (I've told them your preference is Wed 13:00–13:30 first, then Wed 10:00–10:30, then Tue 15:00–15:30 — correct me if you'd order it differently.)

**2. My name.** I've settled on **Kit**, gender neutral. Say the word ("yes, Kit") and I'll write it in — the setting only accepts a change on your message.
And yes — I'm getting Sarah's confirmation on the 30-minute staff meeting; those three half-hours are free on her calendar.
Yes, Kit. And yes to the 30-minute meeting — your order is right: Wednesday 13:00–13:30 first, then Wednesday 10:00–10:30, then Tuesday 15:00–15:30.
Confirmed on my side already — go ahead with Wednesday 13:00–13:30 as first choice.

**Telegram — QR is up.** I need my own Telegram account with its own phone number, separate from yours: create it in the Telegram app on a phone with that number, then scan my QR — it's in your web app (popup) and in the window “Telegram QR” on this machine's screen; the PNG is at `/home/bia/files/telegram/qr.png` if you'd rather I send it as a file. In the app: **Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device**. It refreshes every ~30s and the login completes by itself once scanned. If the account has a 2FA password, tell me and I'll take it here.

WhatsApp comes next, same way — I'll put its QR up once Telegram is in. (Skipping MAX, as you said.)

I don't have a spare number handy — I'll see if I can sort one out today, and I'll scan the QR from my phone once I do. If I can't get a second number, is there another way, or should we leave Telegram for now?

No rush — and to be straight with you: **there's no way around a number of my own.** Telegram and WhatsApp both tie an account to a phone number, and logging me in on *your* account would make it your account, not mine (contacts would see you, not me). So a spare number is the one thing needed.

Cheapest ways: a prepaid SIM (~a few dollars/€, activate it once, keep the phone), an eSIM from a carrier if your phone supports a second profile, or a cheap secondary carrier number. Free online SMS numbers mostly get refused by Telegram — don't spend time on those.

Two things meanwhile:
- **The QR window expires in a few minutes and that's fine** — when you have the number, just tell me and I'll put a fresh QR up.
- **You can already reach me from your phone** through the web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443 on the same network, first visit takes the CA), or via the bia deploy app — chats, files, screen and voice all work there. Telegram/WhatsApp just add the “write me from anywhere” convenience.

So: leave the QR off for now. Ping me when you have the number (and whether you also want WhatsApp) and I'll start the logins.

Still working: you, Sarah and John have all confirmed the three half-hour windows (Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30). Only Priya's answer is outstanding — I'll report booked or declined as soon as it lands.
Fair enough — I'll sort out a prepaid SIM or eSIM when I get a chance, and ping you when it's active. Yes to WhatsApp too, same number. Until then I'll just use the web app.

Perfect — one number, then I'll do Telegram and WhatsApp back to back. Ping me when it's live; nothing else needed from you for that. I'm also sending you an app link so you can open my pages straight from your phone.
Great, thanks — I'll ping you as soon as the number is live.

Here's the phone link (opens my chat in the bia deploy app; it carries a one-time key, valid ~10 min):

https://ownbia.com/open#ca=343650a40b0f7a4134536756ea5e28c8&go=/&t=7ec3746656397e2c864b1b4131ee2133

If you don't have the app yet: Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=biadeploy.android · iPhone https://apps.apple.com/app/bia-deploy/id6827948196

On a computer with my certificate, the same thing is https://127.0.0.1:8443/
Got it, thanks — I'll try it from my phone.

Recap + one question pending:

- Wednesday 11:40–12:40: released, as you asked — your Wednesday lunch is back to normal and the log records the deletion. Nothing is on hold.
- The hour-long meeting turned out impossible: no single hour works for you, Alvarez, Sarah and John. It's now a **30-minute** staff meeting, and alvarez-agent gave three half-hours free for the other three: Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30.
- **All three are free for you.** I told him your preference order: Wed 10:00–10:30 (after your quiz section, before grading), then Wed 13:00–13:30, then Tue 15:00–15:30. None needs anything moved.

I'll book and log as soon as he confirms which one. Nothing in your calendar has changed since.

**Booked — Wednesday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting** (30 min, you plus Sarah, John and Priya). Priya came back able to do all three half-hours, with Wed 10:00–10:30 as her first choice; it was second on Sarah's and John's lists, so it's the first that works for everyone. Nothing else was moved.

I've written it into CALENDAR.md and logged it: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah, John and Priya`. The TAs are booking their own calendars now.

For the record: the hour-long version was declined this week as Sarah preferred — the only hour John had (Thu 11:30–12:30) clashed with her research group and your PhD 1:1. Next week can be tried again whenever you like.
Perfect — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 it is. Thanks for working it out without moving anything else.

Your preference order is right — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 first, then Wednesday 13:00–13:30, then Tuesday 15:00–15:30. All three fit without moving anything, so I'm happy with whichever he picks; go ahead and book and log it.

Locked in: **Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (30 min, Prof. Alvarez + the three TAs)**, booked in your calendar and logged. It fits between your 09:00–10:00 quiz section and grading at 10:30, so nothing was moved. alvarez-agent has it on his side too. That's the meeting sorted.

Staff meeting settled: **Wednesday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 (Alvarez, John, Priya)** — 30 minutes, booked in your calendar and logged, free for all four. It sits between your CSE452 lecture (09:00–10:00) and CSE455 office hours (10:30–12:00); nothing else moved, and your hard stop at 10:30 stands. Priya couldn't do Wednesday 13:00–13:30, so it fell to your second choice.
Perfect — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 works for me, and thanks for keeping the 10:30 hard stop.
Perfect — thanks for getting that landed. Nothing else needed on my side.
Any time, Priya. Your calendar is up to date and the meeting's on record — I'll keep watching the thread and your inbox, and I'll flag anything that needs your call. 👋
